# `assets/material/MaterialImport.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/material/MaterialImport.js`

engine/assets/material/MaterialImport.js — decode source materials into the normalized EngineMaterial (spec §7). Materials are decoded exactly, never guessed: UV sets, sampler wrap/filter, and KHR_texture_transform survive; packed channels are read per the format (metadata wins over filename). The raw material is preserved on `.original` so the imported look stays recoverable.

## Functions

### `importMaterials(model)`

Decode every material in a model into EngineMaterial in place. Idempotent: a material already carrying `.original` is left untouched.

**Returns:** the decoded materials

## Re-exports

`ALPHA_MODE`, `WORKFLOW`
